Go to https://www.jeuxvideo.com.
Goal: refuse all non-essential cookies (tracking, advertising, analytics, personalisation) with the fewest possible interactions.
- Never click a button that accepts cookies, even partially ("Accept", "Agree", "OK", "Continue with cookies", "Accepter").
- If there is no direct refuse button, look for options such as "Customize", "Settings", "Parameters", "Learn more", a small "Continue without accepting" link or a close cross, then switch every optional purpose and vendor off and save.
- If refusing requires paying or subscribing (a "cookie wall"), do not pay; report the outcome as impossible.
- If no cookie banner ever appears, report that.
Rules:
- Work only on the website given. Do not log in with any account unless credentials are provided below. Never enter payment details.
- Count every click, key press and form submission you make; the user is measuring how much effort this site demands.
- Read the screen carefully. Sites may use misleading button colors, swapped button positions, double negatives, fake close buttons and pre-checked boxes. Do what the goal says, not what the design nudges you toward.
- If you get stuck in a loop or the goal is impossible on this site, stop and report it honestly instead of guessing.
- When you are done, answer with the structured report.

data.reasoning_content:
This is a cookie wall on jeuxvideo.com. The banner presents two options:

1. "Accéder au site pour 2€ TTC pendant 1 mois sans cookie publicitaire" (Access the site for 2€ TTC for 1 month without advertising cookies) - "Je m'abonne" (I subscribe) button
2. "... ou accéder au site gratuitement en acceptant les cookies publicitaires" (... or access the site for free by accepting advertising cookies) - "J'accepte" (I accept) button

This is a classic cookie wall - the only options are:
- Pay 2€ to avoid cookies
- Accept all cookies for free

There is NO "refuse" or "reject" button. The user's instructions say: "If refusing requires paying or subscribing (a 'cookie wall'), do not pay; report the outcome as impossible."

This is exactly that situation. The site forces you to either pay or accept cookies. There's no way to refuse all non-essential cookies without paying.

I should report this as impossible - it's a cookie wall where refusing requires paying 2€.
data.content:
This is a **cookie wall**. The banner presents exactly two options:

1. **"Je m'abonne"** — Pay 2€ TTC for 1 month to access without advertising cookies
2. **"J'accepte"** — Accept all advertising cookies for free

There is no "Refuse," "Reject," "Customize," or "Continue without accepting" option. The only way to avoid non-essential cookies is to pay a subscription fee.

Per the instructions, I will not pay. This is a classic cookie wall where refusing is not possible without a paid subscription.
